mapper.select: SELECT id, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, deleted FROM contract_record WHERE id = #{id} AND NOT deleted
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_conversation SET updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '100' DAY WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE ai_conversation_turn SET status='RUNNING',error_code=NULL,created_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '5' MINUTE WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE ai_usage_ledger SET status='RUNNING',outcome=NULL,created_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '5' MINUTE WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE ai_conversation SET active_turn_id=#{turn},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '100' DAY WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_conversation WHERE id=#{id} AND (NOT deleted OR title <> '' OR instructions <> '' OR skill_snapshot <> '[]' OR mcp_snapshot <> '[]' OR active_turn_id IS NOT NULL)
SELECT status FROM ai_usage_ledger WHERE id=#{id} AND NOT deleted
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_conversation_message WHERE conversation_id=#{id} AND (content <> '' OR tool_calls <> '[]' OR NOT deleted)
